review_text: The place is great and quite spacious. Perfect for studying and relaxing at the same time. I got there by 11:30 pm but sadly they close at 12:30 so I really didn't get much time to study. But the ambience and food is great, really good to hangout with friends .

I used to think this place was a haunted house until I stopped by for a drink one midnight. The food is good but a bit pricey 🤑. They specialize in ☕ 🍫 drinks, cakes, and typical coffee shop fare. They're almost open 24/7, with a brief cut-off for cleaning. Payment options include cash, cards, and cashless methods. The venue offers both cool, air-conditioned indoor seating and a pleasant outdoor ambiance, though it can get hot during peak hours. However, it can be challenging to find space when students, freelance workers, or others use it as a library, study room, or workplace. This might inconvenience customers who also want to use the facilities.

Honestly, they have the best cake selection in a cafe, much better than starbucks. Every cake i tasted has yet to disappoint me. I ordered their flat white and it was really good. I love the space because it's so spacious and each table mostly has an outlet which is pretty convenient if you're planning to study there as there are a lot of rooms to choose from. They have a 2nd floor area along with a basement area so you just have to take your pick. I also love the lighting of the space, it's very conducive for reading. It was around 6pm when we got there and there were only 2 barristas on the counter and both were taking turns making the drinks, slicing the cakes, and manning the cash register. Kudos to them for managing but they should add more staff to the counter to lessen the burden so that one of them could just focus with the payments of the customers.

Best place to study in Davao! Been coming here ever since college days (that’s around 2011-2014). Really love the ambiance of the place because it’s an old house converted to a coffee shop. And I do have a soft spot for old places! Shop opens as early as 7am and close at 1am. Pre-pandemic, Green Coffee shops are operating 24/7. They provide 4-hour worth of wifi for free. As for the coffee, it’s just alright. Nothing amazing about it. Their matcha drink is rather very sweet. Cakes are good but that really depends on what type/flavor you’ll have. You might consider going for their signature cakes right away! Overall, it’s the entirety of the place that keeps me coming back to basically chill and hangout. Mode of payment: Cash only Wifi: Yes, free 4 hours per purchase item

I needed my morning coffee. The taste is wonderful. I am drinking a Americano. It's just espresso shots. But I am very pleased with the taste. This place is very beautiful. You feel like you are in a movie or something. It's not haunted at all but it is a treat to have coffee and relax. Outdoor seating is not hot they have trees and a special roof so wala enit. I definitely will have coffee here again when I am in the area.
Lots of charging space and the WiFi is blazing fast!! The only thing is that they don't have savory foods only pastries in store. Hope they stretch out their menu!

👍 Dark mocha tasted bitterly delicious. Prices are a bit expensive. 👍 Lots of cakes that taste good. Also expensive. 👌 Average pasta. There should be more food choices. Something savory instead of everything on the menu being sweet. 👎 Restroom doesn't have proper ventilation, it stinks a lot; only one restroom available for male & female. And that's not good since when's it's too crowded, and you really want to pee, you have to wait for awhile. 👍 Workers are attentive. 👍 Lots of seats available. 👍 Overall ambiance is good, especially at night. 👎 No proper parking spot, especially when it's crowded.
I rate the food 1 star. Out of 4 beverages we ordered, only the chocolate chip was heaven, the others are lile hell. Idk how the barista made those coffee and fruit blend
